verdict.rationale: Blueprints are documented as giving designers "virtually the full range" of programmer concepts, and C++ gameplay classes integrate with the editor through the reflection system, with BlueprintCallable linking the two. Community reports add real caveats on productivity: Blueprints become inefficient at high complexity, and C++ is a friction point for some users. Debugging evidence is limited to a single mention of play-testing "for testing and debugging" from the toolbar. Missing for 10: documented debugger (breakpoints/stepping for Blueprints or C++), evidence that one scripting language is both productive and exposes the full engine API, and independent hands-on corroboration of scripting productivity.
